title: FAA UAP reports, batch 12 (237UAP00286 - 237UAP00310)
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA Skywatch incident reports regarding UAP sightings; most entries are distant light sightings, but two reports describe specific physical objects at close range.

encounters.summary: Pilot reported a round, black and white oblong object approximately the size of an Embraer E-145 aircraft traveling at FL360-370.
encounters.entity_appearance: round, black and white oblong object
encounters.quote: round, black and white oblong object approximately the size of an Embraer E-145 aircraft

encounters.summary: Pilot reported a silver, softball-sized object moving W/SW while descending through FL180.
encounters.quote: silver and the size of a softball
